questions.question: She said, 'I'm not going to the party tonight.' What did she say?
options: I'm going to the party tonight
I won't go to the party tonight
She's not going to the party tonight
I've been invited to the party tonight
questions.answer: She said, 'I'm not going to the party tonight.'

questions.question: The new employee was given a lot of information about the company's policies.
options: Many employees were given this information
This information is very important for new employees
The employee had already known all about these policies
Information about the company's policies is usually given to everyone
questions.answer: The new employee was given a lot of information about the company's policies.

questions.question: If I had studied harder, I would have passed the exam.
options: I will study harder next time
I didn't pass the exam because I didn't study hard enough
I'm glad I didn't pass the exam
I'll never take an exam again
questions.answer: If I had studied harder, I would have passed the exam.

questions.question: The manager asked her team to 'get on with it' and finish the project.
options: She was very impressed with their work
They were all very tired of working on this project
He wanted them to hurry up and complete the task
They had already finished the project
questions.answer: The manager asked her team to 'get on with it' and finish the project.

questions.question: By the time I arrived, they had eaten most of the food.
options: They were still eating when I arrived
I was very hungry because I hadn't eaten all day
The food was delicious, so we ate a lot of it
We should have waited for you before eating
questions.answer: By the time I arrived, they had eaten most of the food.

questions.question: According to the report, the company's profits increased by 20% last year.
options: The company made a loss last year
This is very good news for the shareholders
The profits were lower than expected
The increase in profits was due to a rise in sales
questions.answer: According to the report, the company's profits increased by 20% last year.

questions.question: The teacher suggested that they should 'look up' the information online.
options: She wanted them to read a book about it
They were already experts in this field
He recommended searching for more sources
It was too difficult to find the right information
questions.answer: The teacher suggested that they should 'look up' the information online.

questions.question: I'm not sure if I'll be able to attend the meeting tomorrow.
options: It's definitely a great opportunity
You're probably going to miss it
The meeting will be very boring, so you shouldn't go
It depends on your schedule
questions.answer: I'm not sure if I'll be able to attend the meeting tomorrow.

questions.question: The new policy aims to 'bring about' a significant reduction in waste.
options: This will have a negative impact on the environment
It's already been implemented with great success
They want to increase production and reduce costs
The goal is to make people more aware of their actions
questions.answer: The new policy aims to 'bring about' a significant reduction in waste.

questions.question: The company's success can be attributed to the hard work and dedication of its employees.
options: This is not true, they were very lazy
It was due to good luck rather than effort
They were all very skilled and experienced
The manager played a crucial role in their success
questions.answer: The company's success can be attributed to the hard work and dedication of its employees.
